schedule.name: Adult: chronic heart or lung disease, alcohol use or smoking
schedule.description: Chronic heart disease, chronic lung disease, alcohol use disorder, tobacco use. Applies on top of the adult age schedule only for patients a clinician has put on it; its rules replace the age rule for the same vaccine.

rules.review_reason: Pneumococcal: choose PCV15 (then PPSV23 at least 1 year later; 8 weeks if immunocompromised), PCV20 or PCV21. Check earlier PCV13 and PPSV23 doses first.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, chronic heart or lung disease, alcohol use or smoking: age 19 or older, 1 dose of PCV15, PCV20 or PCV21 if no earlier conjugate vaccine

rules.review_reason: Age 50 to 74 with chronic heart or lung disease: 1 dose RSV vaccine (isolated hypertension does not count). Confirm.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, chronic heart or lung disease, alcohol use or smoking: 1 dose RSV vaccine at 50 to 74 with increased risk
